name: Pocket-ID
description: A simple, passkey-only OIDC and OAuth 2.0 provider for your self-hosted apps

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database, uploaded logos and pictures, the GeoLite2 location database and .encryption_key, this install's own key made on first start. Back this folder up; the data can't be read without the key.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Pocket ID web UI and API, published on host as 6157

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: APP_URL
variables.description: The exact address you open Pocket ID at, like https://id.example.com. Passkeys only work on https, or on http://localhost on this device. Passkeys are locked to this address, so set it before you make your admin account and do not change it later.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.
